verdict_vs_market.quote: For a Google L6 PM, this is a solid offer that sits a bit above the middle of the market.

verdict_vs_current.quote: Meta's IC6 corresponds to Google's L6, so a typical IC6 PM at Meta already earns more than this offer averages.

recommendation.quote: you shouldn't accept it without negotiating. You weren't looking and you're happy where you are, so your fallback is staying put.

equity_grounding.quote: Levels.fyi data from October 2026 puts L5 at $410K, L6 at $612K for Meta PMs.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: On Levels.fyi, Google PM pay rises to $514,125 at L6. The middle half of L6 PMs earn roughly $419,700 to $671,136.

caveat_tenure_current_employer.quote: If you've been at Meta a few years, those refreshes have stacked up, and your current pay probably won't drop off the way this offer does

refresh_valued_at.quote: move only if Google's 4-year average (without counting refreshes) beats your Meta run-rate by about 15% or more.

level_claim.quote: Meta's IC6 corresponds to Google's L6

walkaway_tied_to.quote: Walk away if Google can't get to a 4-year average that clearly beats your Meta run-rate.
